Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 3-1 at 820 N California Ave

Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                            ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No 3-1 in an area bounded by:

The alley next west of and parallel to North California Avenue; a line 216.00 feet north of and
parallel to West Chicago Avenue; North California Avenue; and a line 191.00 feet north of
and parallel to West Chicago Avenue;

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District, and a corresponding use district is hereby
established in the area above described.


SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and elTect from and after its passage and due
publication.
